transactions.desc: The Angels promoted Alvarez from Single-A Rancho Cucamonga to High-A Tri-City on Tuesday.
The Guardians recalled Genao from Triple-A Columbus on Wednesday.
Cleveland designated Arias for assignment Wednesday.
The Cubs optioned Kelly to Triple-A Iowa on Wednesday.
The White Sox reinstated Hays (calf) from the 60-day injured list and designated him for assignment Wednesday.
Baltimore optioned Nunez to Triple-A Norfolk on Wednesday.
The Blue Jays recalled Lee from Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday.
Toronto recalled Estrada from Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday.
Toronto demoted Dallas to Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday.
The Nationals released Wiemer on Wednesday.
The Rangers reinstated Bradford (elbow) from the 60-day injured list ahead of his scheduled start Wednesday versus the Giants in Arlington.
The Mets released Tauchman on Wednesday.
The Blue Jays recalled Estrada from Triple-A Buffalo on Monday and optioned him to Triple-A on Tuesday.
The Pirates released Ozuna on Wednesday, Colin Beazley of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.
Arizona recalled Abner from Triple-A Reno on Wednesday, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.
The Padres added Workman to the 26-man active roster ahead of Tuesday's game against the Diamondbacks.
The Cubs released Blach on Saturday.
Wantz elected free agency Monday.
The Cubs designated Little for assignment Monday.
The Padres optioned Duran to Triple-A El Paso on Tuesday.
The Padres optioned Sears to Triple-A El Paso on Tuesday.
The Tigers recalled Diaz from Triple-A Toledo on Tuesday, Evan Woodbery of MLive.com reports.
The Mets outrighted Melendez to Triple-A Syracuse on Tuesday.
The Mets outrighted Herget to Triple-A Syracuse on Tuesday.
The Red Sox released Kahnle on Tuesday, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
The Cubs optioned Alcantara to Triple-A Iowa on Tuesday.
The Cubs designated Woodford for assignment Tuesday, Jared Wyllys of AllCHGO.com reports.
The Rockies selected Mushinski from Triple-A Albuquerque on Tuesday.
The Rays optioned Piper to Double-A Montgomery on Tuesday, though he'll remain with the big-league club through Wednesday's series finale in Colorado as a member of the taxi squad.
Donovan (groin) was activated from the 10-day injured list Tuesday and is starting at third base versus the Tigers, Daniel Kramer of MLB.com reports.
